name: Cade
description: A telekinetic rogue and sorcerer who serves as the co-manager and 'white hat' security for Trollskull Manor. He is a young man in his early twenties, often hidden beneath a long brown poncho, with bruised knuckles, white-taped fingers, and a left eye that glows cyan blue amidst lightning-bolt scars.
key_facts: He previously worked as a drug deliverer before Havik brought him into legitimate security work at the Golden Horn Gambling Hall.
He utilizes shadow daggers, psychic blades, and telekinesis in combat and stealth operations.
He forged a moonlight familiar named Syldan from his own shadow to counter an icy, shadowy shard implanted in his chest by cultists during his childhood.
He oversees the taproom operations, coordinates security drills, and manages the heavy Yronwood drop-down shutters alongside Havik.
He acts as a professional and street-smart operator, negotiating deals to bring specialized security and equipment to the manor.
gm_notes: Cade is a highly capable physical and magical security asset. His traumatic backstory involving frost giants, cultists, and the dark shard in his chest provides deep narrative hooks regarding his new familiar, Syldan.

name: Havik
description: A goblin sorcerer who acts as the co-manager, security lead, and handler of the urchin intelligence network at Trollskull Manor. He wears a patched cloak of mismatched colors and views the world through gold-rimmed spectacles and gold-flecked eyes.
key_facts: He brought Cade into legitimate security work to keep him out of the criminal underworld.
He strictly follows a set of 'Goblin Rules,' such as Rule #37 (take any deal involving a thousand gold per noble) and Rule #64 (take the loot immediately).
He wields chaos magic, casting spells like Chaos Bolt, and utilizes physical illusions like smoke daggers.
He coordinates daily intelligence debriefings with the urchins—Nat, Jenks, and Squidly—gathering street rumors about rival factions.
He collaborated with the ghost Lif to create a spectrally layered dark porter for the tavern's patrons.
gm_notes: Havik is highly pragmatic and opportunistic, but fiercely protective of his friends and the urchins. He provides excellent tactical oversight and magical defense for the tavern operations.

name: Garrett
description: A changeling wizard and resident scholar who operates the Trollskull Manor library. Abandoned at a Sanctuary of Oghma as a featureless infant, he views a 'True Face' as a liability and prefers to navigate the world using 'Borrowed Faces'.
key_facts: His primary persona is 'Elara Moonwhisper,' an elegant Moon Elf socialite and information broker who infiltrates high society to gather intelligence.
He also utilizes the persona of 'Scribe Jaxen Thann,' a spindly, ink-stained bureaucrat.
He curates the manor's collection of tomes, maps out faction ledgers, and provides the staff with vital intelligence briefings.
He supplies the manor with defensive, investigative, and utility spell scrolls, such as Alarm, Arcane Lock, and Detect Thoughts.
He maintains magical wards around the library to prevent scrying or magical eavesdropping from rival factions.
gm_notes: Garrett is the ultimate infiltrator and information broker. His ability to effortlessly shift personas allows him to gather secrets from the city's nobility and criminal syndicates while managing the party's arcane defenses.

name: Spider
description: A specialized, four-armed Warforged construct designed with a non-binary, masculine-coded persona, who operates as the tireless bartender and primary bouncer for Trollskull Manor.
key_facts: He requires no biological sleep, maintaining a 24-hour taproom vigil while periodically entering a low-power diagnostic state.
He uses his four arms to effortlessly pour multiple drinks, organize glassware, and simultaneously grapple up to four unruly patrons without striking them.
He can cast the Mage Hand cantrip to act as a fifth appendage for manipulating his environment.
He carries a copper flask of unsalted sunflower seeds to feed local pigeons and keep them out of the manor's chimneys.
He carries a steel flask of 55% sweet brandy, which he administers to witnesses after a brawl to calm them down before the City Watch arrives.
gm_notes: Spider's methodology is entirely non-lethal, allowing him to bypass the legal risks of the Code Legal while providing unparalleled crowd control. His immunity to poison and exhaustion makes him a flawless, immovable point of defense.

name: Lif
description: The resident poltergeist of Trollskull Manor, the spirit of a former proprietor who died when he was crushed by an ale cask in the cellar. He was pacified by the party and now serves as an invisible, highly efficient member of the staff.
key_facts: Every dawn, he metaphorically re-enacts the moment of his death in the cellar before drifting upstairs to begin his cleaning shift.
He communicates with the living by writing neat, phantom script in the dust, leaving messages like 'OPEN FOR BUSINESS' and 'LAST CALL'.
He assists the staff by magically washing dishes, polishing the Yronwood bar, sweeping the floors, and hanging up wet coats.
He acts as a spectral guardian for the urchins and subtly assists contractors like Tally Fellbranch during renovations.
He worked with Havik to invent the 'Lif Special,' a spectrally layered dark porter that perfectly suspends ale atop a measure of high-proof liquor.
gm_notes: Lif transforms the haunted nature of the tavern from a liability into a unique selling point and a logistical boon. He is fiercely loyal to the new owners for restoring his beloved tavern and treats the establishment as his eternal charge.
